subject: Demo: Streamline — calendar invite showing wrong zone when forwarded
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@streamline.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:00:00+02:00
Subject: Demo — Streamline: proposed time + invite attached

Hi Tom / Markus,

Thanks again for the interest — confirming a 45-minute product walk-through for Streamline. I created a Google Calendar invite for:

  • Wednesday, 11 Aug 2026, 10:00 AM CEST (UTC+2)

I've attached the .ics (Streamline-demo.ics) generated by Google. Can you confirm that works for you and whether we should include any additional attendees? If anything looks off when you forward the invite, please paste screenshots — we've seen forwarding sometimes cause the timezone to display differently in other calendars.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen\Account Executive\Redwood Inference
Attachments: Streamline-demo.ics (text/calendar)

---
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@streamline.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiroko Sato <hiroko.sato@mirai.jp>
Date: 2026-08-04T20:30:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Demo — Streamline: proposed time + invite attached

Hi Stephanie — thanks for setting this up. 10:00 CEST looks fine for our EMEA folks.

One issue: I forwarded the invite to our Japan office (Hiroko) and she reported the invite showed as a "floating" entry and landed at 5:00 PM on her calendar instead of 6:00 PM JST (should be 6:00 PM JST for a 10:00 AM CEST meeting). I pasted the forwarded message header below (she forwarded it back to me):

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Subject: Demo — Streamline: proposed time + invite attached
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 09:00:00 +0200
To: t.ellis@streamline.ai
Content-Type: text/calendar; method=REQUEST; charset=UTF-8

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART:20260811T100000
DTEND:20260811T104500
UID:abc123@google.com
SUMMARY:Streamline demo
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

Her calendar picked that DTSTART up as "floating" (no timezone attached) and translated it incorrectly. She sees 17:00 local time instead of 18:00 JST. We use Google for EMEA/US and MS Exchange for Japan — forwarding often strips the TZID.

Can you regenerate with explicit TZ components (TZID=Europe/Paris and an equivalent for Asia/Tokyo) or send separate invites targeted to her timezone? Attaching a screenshot she sent.

Tom
Attachment: screenshot-forwarded-ics.png (image/png)

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@streamline.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T00:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — Streamline: proposed time + invite attached

Nice catch, Tom — this is a pretty common issue when an ICS is generated without timezone definitions.

Quick explanation: when an ICS has DTSTART/DTEND in local 'floating' format (no Z / no TZID), some calendar clients treat it as absolute local time for the recipient rather than converting between timezones. That matches the symptoms Hiroko saw.

Options to resolve:
- Regenerate the ICS with explicit TZID entries (e.g., TZID=Europe/Paris; include VTIMEZONE section). That preserves semantics across forwards. (I've created a patched ICS: Streamline-demo-updated.ics)
- Create separate invites for each region (one for EMEA at 10:00 CEST, one for APAC at 18:00 JST) and mark the original as a private/calendar placeholder — more work but robust.
- Alternatively add the meeting in UTC in the body and ask people to add to their calendars manually.

I'm attaching the updated ICS that includes a VTIMEZONE block and explicit TZIDs. I also added brief setup notes in notes-setup.pdf for the call (login links, test steps, what to share).

If you want, I can create an APAC-targeted invite and add Hiroko directly so Exchange receives an invite with TZID.

— Markus
Attachments: Streamline-demo-updated.ics (text/calendar), notes-setup.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@streamline.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hiroko Sato <hiroko.sato@mirai.jp>

Thanks Tom — and thanks Markus for the quick patch.

Plan:
1) I'm attaching the updated ICS Markus produced. Markus, please also create the APAC-targeted invite and add Hiroko directly so Exchange receives TZID (if you can, mark it as an attendee invite rather than a forwarded file).
2) Tom/Hiroko: please confirm on your side that the new invite shows 11 Aug 18:00 JST / 11 Aug 10:00 CEST. If not, reply with a screenshot (we'll fallback to separate region invites).
3) I'll update the HubSpot deal (STRM-4729) with the event link.

Thanks — apologies for the friction; this kind of TZ mismatch is unfortunately common when calendars cross clients.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen\Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Streamline-demo-updated.ics, notes-setup.pdf
